description: Delete a data model by title and server using the GraphQL ECM endpoint.

title.description: The exact title of the data model to delete.

server.description: The server name where the model is hosted (for example ``"LocalHost"``).

examples.user_query: How can I delete the 'Sales Data' model from the LocalHost server?
examples.notes: This call deletes the 'Sales Data' data model hosted on the LocalHost server. Use this when the model is no longer needed or needs to be replaced.

examples.user_query: I need to remove the 'Marketing Analytics' model from the 'AnalyticsServer'. How can I do that?

examples.user_query: Can you help me delete the 'Customer Insights' model from the 'DataHubServer'?

description: Resolve a data model reference (ID or title) to a concrete data model ID and title.

datamodel_ref.description: Data model reference to resolve. This can be either an ID or a name.

examples.user_query: What is the ID and title of the data model named 'Sales Analytics'?
examples.notes: This resolves the data model reference 'Sales Analytics' to its concrete ID and title. Use this when you know the title of the data model but need its ID.

examples.user_query: Can you find the details for the data model with ID '63f9c1d2e4b0a123456789ab'?
examples.notes: This resolves the data model reference '63f9c1d2e4b0a123456789ab' to its concrete ID and title. Use this when you already have the ID of the data model.

examples.user_query: I need the ID and title for the data model called 'Marketing Dashboard'.
examples.notes: This resolves the data model reference 'Marketing Dashboard' to its concrete ID and title. Use this when you know the title of the data model but need its ID for further operations.
